name: voice_verification_exhausted
content: Its code checks kept failing and the repair attempts ran out, so that code is not working yet.

metadata.description: Spoken clause for verification_state `exhausted` — the checks failed, repair was attempted and gave up. This is NOT a success, and the sentence must not be reachable by anyone skimming for good news: it names the failure and the fact that the automatic attempts are over, because the next move is the user's.
